cohort: The study included 4,390 obstetric patients aged 18 years or older who had 6,612 obstetric triage visits between January 1, 2022, to February 28, 2023.
finding: Nonadmitted patients, those with high-risk maternal-fetal medicine status, and preterm patients evaluated during daytime and weekdays experienced significantly longer lengths of stay in obstetric triage.
